knowledge:
- key_parameters: expressionset=The input microarray data container (e.g., AffyBatch, ExpressionSet, NChannelSet) ;; outdir=Character string specifying the output directory for the HTML report ;; force=Logical; if TRUE, overwrites the output directory if it already exists ;; do.logtransform=Logical; if TRUE, applies a logarithmic transformation to the intensities (necessary for raw data like AffyBatch before preprocessing) ;; intgroup=Character vector specifying names of columns in the phenoData slot to color-code plots and heatmaps by experimental factors
- alternatives: rma() from the affy package for preprocessing Affymetrix data before running quality metrics ;; justvsn() from the vsn package for variance stabilization normalization of two-color arrays ;; ArrayExpress package to download datasets directly from the EBI ArrayExpress database instead of local files
- when_to_use: When assessing the quality of a raw microarray dataset to identify experimental/technical issues, or when assessing a normalized/preprocessed microarray dataset to decide whether to exclude specific outlier arrays before downstream differential expression analysis.
- pitfalls: Forgetting to set do.logtransform = TRUE when analyzing raw, non-log-transformed data (like raw AffyBatch), which can distort intensity-based metrics ;; Failing to provide X and Y coordinates in the featureData slot when spatial layout plots are desired for non-Affymetrix/non-BeadLevelList platforms ;; Including too much or too little metadata in the phenoData slot, which can make the interactive report table cluttered or uninformative.

workflows.name: standard_qc_report
workflows.intent: Generate a standard, comprehensive HTML quality report from a microarray data container.
input: MLL.A (AffyBatch object containing raw Affymetrix data)
CCl4 (NChannelSet object containing raw two-color microarray data)
workflows.stages: 1. Load raw data ;; 2. Run arrayQualityMetrics on raw data with log transformation ;; 3. Preprocess data (using rma or justvsn) ;; 4. Run arrayQualityMetrics on preprocessed data ;; 5. Add experimental factors or spatial coordinates to metadata ;; 6. Run arrayQualityMetrics with metadata factors
workflows.code:
library("ALLMLL")
data("MLL.A")
library("arrayQualityMetrics")
arrayQualityMetrics(expressionset = MLL.A[, 1:5],
                    outdir = "Report_for_MLL_A",
                    force = TRUE,
                    do.logtransform = TRUE)
nMLL = rma(MLL.A)
arrayQualityMetrics(expressionset = nMLL,
                    outdir = "Report_for_nMLL",
                    force = TRUE)
library("vsn")
library("CCl4")
data("CCl4")
nCCl4 = justvsn(CCl4, subsample = 15000)
arrayQualityMetrics(expressionset = nCCl4,
                    outdir = "Report_for_nCCl4",
                    force = TRUE)
pData(nMLL)$condition = rep(letters[1:4], times = 5)
pData(nMLL)$batch = rep(paste(1:4), each = 5)
arrayQualityMetrics(expressionset = nMLL,
                    outdir = "Report_for_nMLL_with_factors",
                    force = TRUE,
                    intgroup = c("condition", "batch"))
featureData(nCCl4)$X = featureData(nCCl4)$Row
featureData(nCCl4)$Y = featureData(nCCl4)$Column
featureData(nCCl4)$hasTarget = (regexpr("^NM", featureData(nCCl4)$Name) > 0)
pd = pData(CCl4)
rownames(pd) = NULL
RIN = with(pd, ifelse( Cy3=="CCl4", RIN.Cy3, RIN.Cy5))
fRIN = factor(RIN)
levels(fRIN) = c("poor", "medium", "good")
pData(nCCl4)$"RNA-integrity" = fRIN
arrayQualityMetrics(expressionset = nCCl4,
                    outdir = "Report_for_nCCl4_with_RIN",
                    force = TRUE,
                    intgroup = "RNA-integrity")

workflows.name: custom_modular_qc_report
workflows.intent: Programmatically build a customized quality report by selecting specific modules and manually rendering the report.
input: MLL.A (AffyBatch object containing raw Affymetrix data)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare data using prepdata to perform common pre-computations ;; 2. Generate individual report modules using functions like aqm.boxplot and aqm.density ;; 3. Combine modules into a list ;; 4. Inspect outlier detection statistics programmatically ;; 5. Render the report using aqm.writereport
workflows.code:
library("arrayQualityMetrics")
library("ALLMLL")
data("MLL.A")
preparedData = prepdata(expressionset = MLL.A, 
                        intgroup = c(), 
                        do.logtransform = TRUE)
bo = aqm.boxplot(preparedData)
de = aqm.density(preparedData)
qm = list("Boxplot" = bo, "Density" = de)
bo@outliers
outdir = tempdir()
aqm.writereport(modules = qm, reporttitle = "My example", outdir = outdir, 
                arrayTable = pData(MLL.A))
outdir
